sections.title: Mark report resolved handler
sections.what: Marks the named report in the named crew as resolved for the signed-in caller and returns an empty success response.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the resolve action.
sections.watch_out: The route trusts the moderation service to check both the rights and that the report belongs to this crew.

summary: Lets someone with the right rights mark a member report as resolved.
purpose: Closes out reports so the crew owner can track which ones are dealt with.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the mark-resolved button.
how: 1) Confirms the caller is signed in. 2) Reads the crew and report ids from the address. 3) Calls the resolve service. 4) Returns an empty success response.
inputs: A POST request with crew and report ids in the address. The caller comes from the session.
outputs: An empty 204 response when the report is marked resolved.
risks: The route does not check rights itself, so the service must confirm the caller may resolve this report.
debug: If resolving fails, check the resolve function in the moderation service and that the report belongs to the crew named in the address.
